- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/V3_MIGRATION_GUIDE.md`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.

Coarse fallback — **136** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 96fdac21ee7182f52c1326fc1f29166231b3a8e8` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: 82/82 `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `8ac750cfe9620a837e29adc8f2d5727b890b5d51`

Reviewed against merge-base `62b114f8b8` (PR branch `claude/issue-18753-guide-unpublished-subpaths`) with every rule read from `origin/main` at `96fdac21ee` and every tree reading taken there or at the PR head; nothing was read from the working tree. Diff face: 2 files, +230 / -19, exactly the two files the card claim declared.

Evidence discipline. The card's comment fetch returned the dispatching seat's claim (5723792315), its self-correction (5723878949) and its review reply (5724220495); all three are seat conclusions and are disregarded here. The os-dev-report (5724178265) was used only as the source of the two `open_questions`, which the PR body restates verbatim. The triage comment (5719698425, triage seat) is treated as the standing ruling that the card must become a fixture of the census instrument, which is what puts half (B) in scope. Every number below is my own measurement.

### ① Derived judgments

1. `packages/spec/V3_MIGRATION_GUIDE.md` is not a published surface. `@objectstack/spec` `files[]` on origin/main is `dist, json-schema, liveness, prompts, llms.txt, README.md, src/**/*.zod.ts, CHANGELOG.md, api-surface, spec-changes.json`; evaluated against every package.json in the tree (83), the guide matches 0 `files[]` entries. Positive control on the same evaluator: `packages/spec/README.md` reads true and `packages/spec/dist/index.js` reads true. No `*.zod.ts`, ledger, registry or exports map is touched. Judged: no accept set moves; correct.

2. The document edit removes three claims of a WIDER published surface than exists and adds no claim of anything unpublished. Measured on origin/main: `@objectstack/core` `exports` has exactly `.` and `./logger`; `packages/spec/package.json` has no `./hub` entry and `packages/spec/src/hub` does not exist; `Hub` does not appear in `packages/spec/src/index.ts`; `PluginDefinitionSchema` appears in 0 of the `api-surface/*.json` files (only in `benchmark.bench.ts:120` behind `as any`); `466f32ea22` (2026-02-12) removed `createErrorResponse`, `getHttpStatusForCategory` (`api/errors.zod.ts`) and `definePlugin` (`kernel/plugin.zod.ts`) and added no file under `packages/core/src` named errors or plugin, then or since (`git log --all` over those paths is empty); the guide was created by `097c4d8c0e` on 2026-02-11. Every sentence the edit now makes was checked against the tree: `ErrorResponseSchema` is exported (`errors.zod.ts:489`, re-exported by `api/index.ts:42`, listed at `api-surface/api.json:364`); `Plugin` with `init` / `start?` / `destroy?` is at `core/src/types.ts:155-215` and reaches `@objectstack/core` through `index.ts:21` `export * from './types.js'`; `TenantSchema` (`system/tenant.zod.ts:178`) and `PluginRegistryEntrySchema` (`kernel/plugin-registry.zod.ts:147`) exist; the five Full Mapping files exist; the checklist's surviving names (`PresenceStatus`, `RealtimeRecordAction`, `RateLimitConfigSchema`, `EventBusConfigSchema`, `EventSchema`, `EventPriority`) are all in `api-surface/*.json` and the three removed aliases are not; `action.zod.ts:972` declares `locations`, not `location`; no inbound anchor names the renamed section "Runtime Logic Extraction" anywhere in the tree. "The three symbols themselves exist nowhere in the codebase" is true of code identifiers: a repo-wide grep over `.ts/.tsx/.js/.mjs/.json` returns only one prose string (`.claude/workflows/docs-accuracy-audit.js:228`, which itself says there is no `definePlugin`), so the grep was live; the names also survive as prose in `CHANGELOG.md:2289-2290`, `packages/spec/DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md:463-465` and `ZOD_SCHEMA_AUDIT_REPORT.md:37,439`, which are outside this PR's fence. Judged: this is a correction of documentation toward the published contract, not a narrowing of any published contract, because the subpaths it stops promising were never in any `exports` map.

3. `scripts/measure-markdown-ts-blocks.mjs` gains two module-level exports (`UNPUBLISHED_SUBPATH_SPECIFIERS`, `UNPUBLISHED_SUBPATH_CONTROL`). This is not public surface. The root `package.json` is `private: true` with no `files[]`; npm `files[]` cannot reach above a package's own directory, so no published package can carry `scripts/`; `git grep measure-markdown-ts-blocks` on origin/main returns only the file itself (no importer, no test, no workflow, no package.json script, nothing under `skills/**`). `scripts/pm/check-widening-tells.mjs --declaration no` on the PR diff exits 0 with both files NOT MEASURED ("no declared surface covers it"); the T3 tell (a new row in a published entry point's export listing) is defined over `packages/spec/api-surface/*.json`, which is untouched. The mechanical floor's sentence "a new exported symbol is always `yes`" (contract-review.md) is scoped by SKILL.md:515 ("Clause ② refers only to the published contract surface") and by the tell implementation; the seat's conservative `yes` was permitted and is not a fault (spec.md:20), but the reviewed direction is not a widening.

4. The census gains a third control on the refusal list. This changes the behaviour of a repo-internal instrument, which no consumer can observe; it is not a contract surface. Behaviour verified rather than read: `--self-test` at head passes 35 cases / 35 batteries (exit 0); at base 30 / 30. A programmatic roster diff of `SELF_TEST_BATTERIES` base vs head: 0 of the original 30 dropped, 5 added, weight sum 30 to 35, `SELF_TEST_BATTERY_FLOOR` 30 to 35 (`:977`). Ablation on a scratch copy (the `@objectstack/` branch of `classifyDiagnostic` flipped to `forgiven: true`, 1 occurrence): `--self-test` exit 1 with 2 failures; `--controls-only` exit 1, refusing and naming all three specifiers as `forgiven=true` plus the outright-forgiven line. That ablated census run is also the LIT reading for the real compile path: the three TS2307s were produced and classified through `extractBlocks` and `tsc` in this container with no `dist/` built, because the `paths` map is generated from each package's exports map and an unlisted subpath is TS2307 regardless. The unablated `--controls-only` refuses only on `GREEN_CONTROL` (unbuilt workspace, a precondition), and its refusal text names no UNPUBLISHED_SUBPATH problem. The fixture is line-for-line the three specifiers the base guide carried at lines 28, 77 and 78.

5. Arm. Under SKILL.md:477 ("does this card widen the accept set or expand the public surface") and spec.md:19-20, this diff widens no accept set and expands no public surface, and it breaks nothing published, so `no (narrowing)` would also be wrong. The declaration should carry `no` with no parenthetical. The standing `yes (widening)` on both carriers is overturned by this review; per spec.md:20 and contract-review.md that overturn is by design and not a seat fault. A re-declaration to `no` would clear the C5 tell row (measured above: NOT MEASURED, exit 0).

### ② Semver level

None. Nothing this diff touches is delivered to any consumer (item ① 1 and 3). The PR carries `skip-changeset`, the diff holds no `.changeset/*.md`, and the `Check Changeset` job defines that label as "this PR declares no release of its own"; `lint.yml:3266-3272` names a CI-internal script edit as the textbook case. Precedent in the same shape: PR #18712 (`packages/core/PHASE2_IMPLEMENTATION.md`, outside `files[]`) merged 2026-09-17 with `skip-changeset`, `Clause-②: no` and no changeset. The lane default "text face changeset is always patch" (spec.md:15) presumes text that ships in the package (describe, JSDoc, error prose reach `dist/`); a root markdown outside `files[]` ships nothing, and a patch on the `fixed` group would version every package for a change no consumer receives. Consistent. One coherence note, not a defect: `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` reads a PR-level `Clause-②: yes` as implying at least one moved package graded minor or above, so `yes (widening)` beside "releases nothing" is self-contradictory in writing and is masked only because `skip-changeset` exempts that job wholesale; carrying `no` (① 5) makes the record coherent.

### ③ Boundary flags

Flag 1, open question 1 (line 28 keeps `@objectstack/spec/hub` in the v2.x block; options A keep / B repoint to `/system` / C de-fence to prose). Answer: A, as shipped. B would make the v2.x and v3.0 blocks identical and have the guide assert that the currently supported import is the one v3.0 removed, which is a new falsehood. C removes an input to a measurement instead of repairing anything. Under A the block is a depiction of removed code under an explicit do-not-copy comment; it makes no contract claim, and the `{ ... }` at line 30 is a TS1109 syntax error, so the block never reaches type-check and produces no TS2307 today (the card's "three measured TS2307" was two, `core/errors` and `core/plugin`). Answered, not escalated.

Flag 2, open question 2 (which arm enters the queue). Answer: `no`, per ① 5. The seat records the reviewed arm on the card in the same stroke that strips the carriers; nothing in the diff needs to change.

Flag 3, the refusal-list placement and its stated cost. Agreed, with the cost measured rather than assumed: on origin/main neither the census nor its `--self-test` is invoked by any workflow or package.json script (0 hits in `.github/`, root `package.json`, `packages/*/package.json`). `scripts/check-self-test-wired.mjs` defines its population as "every script CI runs that ships a `--self-test`", so this script is outside that population and the dev's "covered by check:self-test-wired, green" is true only vacuously. Consequently the day one of the three subpaths is genuinely published, the refusal costs one manual census run and prints its own remedy; it blocks no CI. Such a publication is itself an `exports`-map edit and therefore a `Clause-②: yes` PR whose own contract review is where the fixture repoint gets caught. The gap that matters is not this PR's: the census and its batteries execute only by hand until #18715's wiring decision, and that caveat belongs beside #18715's number. Answered, escalated to the seat only as an input to #18715.

Flag 4, "every sentence the document now makes is true today". Verified for every edited sentence (① 2). One untouched sentence becomes false by this edit: the footer `Last Updated: 2026-02-11` (the header's `Target Release: Q2 2026` was already stale and is noted by the PR). Not a contract matter, does not move the verdict; a one-token follow-up for the seat to fold into this file's next touch.

Flag 5, the dev's noted-not-filed items (family totals are a lower bound because a syntax error hides a block from pass 2; migration guides sit in the `handwritten` stratum whose contract does not fit a before/after document; `benchmark.bench.ts:120` reaches an unexported schema through `as any`; `DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md:463-465`, `ZOD_SCHEMA_AUDIT_REPORT.md` and root `CHANGELOG.md:2289-2290` restate the never-performed relocation). None touches a published accept set or surface and none is in this PR's fence. Escalated to the seat as filing items: the first two to #18715, the last two as new cards; not blocking.

Flag 6, PR checks. At my last poll (2026-09-18 about 02:37Z) 0 check runs had failed; 6 were still in progress (Test Core 1/6, 3/6, 5/6, 6/6; Type Check workspace; Lint and Repo Gates). All-green is the seat's own pre-enqueue read at enqueue time, not this record's. `--pair 18866` reads: derivation `closing-keyword` (Fixes #18753), head `8ac750cfe9`, claim and PR body both `yes (widening)`, `needs:contract-review` on both card and PR.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-18753-guide-unpublished-subpaths`
Reviewed-by: `session_01JbZnqu8bt6YqfJsr9vaFb3`

**VERDICT: PASS**
